examples: Point chat at a local ollama on another computer so app features run on your own model.
Add a cloud provider with your own key, test it, and route speak or image to it.
Open recent calls, switch to 7d and click the top model in where the money goes to see every call it served.
how_to: Press add connection, pick a preset (local, cloud or cli), set the label and base url, and save. A key is write-only: type it once, it is never shown again.
Press test on the connection to see ok or the error, the latency and a sample. Refresh the model list or type a model id.
In routing, pick a connection and model for each capability: type to filter a model list, with recent and popular models on top. Then set per-feature overrides below it.

Open recent calls to see the summary strip (calls, spend, error rate, latency, tokens), where the money goes by feature and model, and the log paged 50 at a time under day headers. Pick 24h, 7d or 30d, filter by feature, connection, model or result, click a spend row to filter by it, click a call to expand its ids and full error. New calls arrive live.
